scope: label-free temporal routing for unseen sites, selected only on authorized development folds

target_domain.purpose: whole-site evaluation stratum approximating the declared low-prevalence unseen-site target

search.formula: for unseen sites with sufficient history, logit(current) + weight * mean(site top-k current logits)

gates.selection_and_confirmation: combined AP improves with positive paired site-bootstrap lower bound and recall does not fall

base_architecture.name: frozen v3 stronger OOF ExtraTrees scene head

interpretation.hypothesis: temporal corroboration improves rare-event ranking specifically at unseen low-prevalence sites
interpretation.independent_confirmation: fixed winner once on folds 0/1 low-prevalence sites
interpretation.routing_at_inference: membership in the frozen training-site set plus group and current scores only

invariants: The 5% prevalence definition selects complete evaluation sites and is never an inference input.
Known training sites remain bitwise on the frozen current score.
All 45 candidates, gates, rank rule, and seeds are frozen before development scoring.
Failure writes no artifact and blocks fresh-safety or exact-paper replay.
